verification: Read-only current-carrier audit for the six remaining rows. Zero hits below were obtained from complete scoped searches, not from substring absence. Device inspection is read-only; no chmod, kill, settings write, sysfs write or service action was executed.

deviceReadOnlyObservations.audioNodes: /dev/snd/pcmC0D*p are mode 0660 system:audio context u:object_r:audio_device:s0; every pcm node shares the same mode, so 0660 is only correct because the current tree happens to use it
deviceReadOnlyObservations.brightnessNodes: /sys/class/backlight/panel0-backlight/{max_brightness,brightness} return Permission denied to the shell user; /sys/class/mi_display/disp-DSI-0/ returns Permission denied

rows.currentCarrier: Device nodes exist and are writable-in-principle only through root. Upstream restores hard-coded 0660 and no persisted owner/mode/selinux snapshot; a process-local boolean cannot survive SystemUI restart or reboot while nodes stay 000.
rows.blockingContract: Need a durable transaction: read every matched node's uid/gid/mode before writing, persist the snapshot outside the SystemUI process, restore exactly that snapshot on disable/boot/refresh failure, and fail closed when a snapshot is missing or a node set changed.
rows.decision: Not implemented. Exposing a tile now would ship a path that can permanently break audio with no verified recovery.

rows.upstream: SunlightModeTile FORCE_MAX_BRIGHTNESS: chmod 777 on /sys/class/mi_display/disp-DSI-0/brightness_clone or /sys/class/backlight/panel0-backlight/brightness, then raw write of Integer.MAX_VALUE
rows.currentCarrier: Both node families exist and are permission-denied to shell. Upstream relies on a manual chmod 777 and writes an int the panel may not accept; it also stores last brightness only in process fields.
rows.blockingContract: Need confirmed max_brightness, accepted value range, ownership/mode snapshot and exact restoration for the chosen node, plus a persistent last-brightness store surviving restart.
rows.decision: Not implemented. The bounded native-mode tile at control_center_sunlight_tile is not a substitute for this row and is not reported as one.

rows.upstream: Custom brightness seek bar consumed by CUSTOM_BRIGHTNESS_SHELL mode through root echo into the backlight node
rows.currentCarrier: Same permission-denied node family as the high mode; the value is capped by /sys/class/backlight/panel0-backlight/max_brightness read at UI build time.
rows.blockingContract: Depends on the same node snapshot/restore contract as the high mode; also needs a validated clamp against the real max_brightness rather than a UI-only maximum.
rows.decision: Not implemented. No placeholder seek bar is exposed.

rows.currentCarrier: Complete Home.apk DEX name searches for NavStubView, RecentsContainer, isMistakeTouch and showLandscapeOverviewGestureView all return zero hits. Home navigation/gesture code is Rust in lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so with no traced DEX or Java bridge. Current SystemUI instead carries a native hide_gesture_line global preference in com.miui.systemui.modulesettings.NavigationSettings and com.miui.systemui.SettingsManager.onHideGestureLineChanged, feeding com.android.systemui.statusbar.phone.NavigationModeControllerInjector.mHideGestureLine.
rows.note: The module already ships the separate gesture_line feature (gesture_pill drawing suppression), which is a different upstream key and target.
rows.blockingContract: Either prove the MiuiWindowManagerShell/Rust gesture-surface code path that the launcher consumes, or map the implementation onto the distinct native hide_gesture_line preference and confirm it is not the same control as the already-shipped gesture_line feature.
rows.decision: Not implemented. No old nonexistent NavStubView hook and no unverified alias of gesture_line.

rows.upstream: FuckStatusbarGestures: reflect CentralSurfacesImpl.mGestureRec.mLogfile and rewrite '/sdcard/...' to '/sdcard/MIUI/...' in all constructors
rows.currentCarrier: Current SystemUI CentralSurfacesImpl complete class read contains no mGestureRec field; dex name searches for GestureRecorder, GestureRecorderImpl and the statusbar_gestures string return zero hits.
rows.blockingContract: Need the current owner of statusbar_gestures.dat before relocating it; blindly moving a guessed file path can break gesture recognition with no recovery.
rows.decision: Not implemented. No empty toggle and no unrelated file move.

rows.blockingContract: The requested user-visible behavior is not defined by upstream code, so there is no target contract to migrate. Analytics label strings are not evidence of the feature.
